subject: exporting / customizing plots from marginal_effects and plot.brms

messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: exporting / customizing plots from marginal_effects and plot.brms
parts:
Hi Paul,
 If I understand correctly the plots from marginal_effects are ggplot2 objects, right? I'm trying to do the following things:

1 - isolate the plots so I can save them at publication size using ggsave()
2 - customize certain elements such as axis labels and title
3 - (potentially) combine plots onto a single axis, as I would do with multiple geom objects

Thanks for any help,
Paul

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] exporting / customizing plots from marginal_effects and plot.brms
parts:
plot(marginal_effects(...)) returns a list of ggplot object each can be handled in the usual way. 

Customizing plots from plot.brmsfit is harder. I recommend creating the dens and trace plots via the stanplot method.
